CorridorKey2LoRA.name: CorridorKey2LoRA
CorridorKey2LoRA.description: Applies a CorridorKey 2.0 LoRA from models/corridorkey2/loras, and/or one wired in from a Fine-Tune node, to the model. The shared base weights are not modified; chain several LoRA nodes to stack adapters.
